section.title: International skilled-worker and apprenticeship placement between Morocco and Germany
section.subtitle: We connect motivated young talent and qualified professionals from Morocco with German companies and training institutions. Our focus is on targeted placement, personal support and long-term career prospects.

items.title: Placement of apprentices
items.desc: We give motivated young people from Morocco access to vocational training (Ausbildung) positions in Germany. We take their school qualifications, language skills and career interests into account to place them in suitable training opportunities across different industries.

items.title: Placement of skilled workers
items.desc: We support qualified professionals from Morocco in finding suitable employment in Germany. By considering their professional skills, work experience and individual career goals, we lay the foundation for a successful placement.

items.title: Recruitment for companies and institutions
items.desc: We help German companies and institutions recruit motivated apprentices and qualified professionals from Morocco. Based on your individual staffing needs, we identify suitable candidates and present matching applicant profiles.

items.title: Cooperation with training and educational institutions
items.desc: We work with nursing schools, training centres and other educational institutions to promote international training opportunities, supporting collaboration between education providers, training companies and suitable applicants from Morocco.

intro.title: Who we are
paragraphs: ChanceConnect specialises in placing apprentices and skilled workers from Morocco with companies and training institutions in Germany.
We guide applicants and employers professionally — from the first application through the visa to successful integration. Our goal is to create opportunities and build long-term partnerships.

meta.title: FAQ
meta.description: Common questions on applying, placement, visa and support — ChanceConnect answers the most important questions.

hero.title: Frequently asked questions
hero.subtitle: Answers to the most important questions from applicants and employers.

faq.title: Questions & answers
faq.subtitle: Can't find your question? Feel free to contact us directly.

items.q: Which countries do your applicants come from?
items.a: Our focus is Morocco. We place motivated young talent and skilled professionals from Morocco with companies and training institutions across Germany.

items.q: Does placement cost anything for employers?
items.a: No. Our recruitment service is free of charge for employers.

items.q: How can I apply as a candidate?
items.a: Simply via WhatsApp or email. Send us your CV and we'll get back to you.
Yes. We arrange online interviews between applicants and employers.

items.q: Do you also support after arrival in Germany?
items.a: Yes. We help with airport pick-up, finding accommodation, registration, bank account, health insurance and dealing with authorities, among others.

items.q: Which languages do you offer your service in?
items.a: We communicate in German, English, French and Arabic.

items.q: In which fields do you place candidates?
items.a: Among others in care & health, gastronomy, hospitality, trades & technical, and industry.

items.q: Do you work with educational institutions?
items.a: Yes. We cooperate with nursing schools, training centres and other educational institutions, and support their collaboration with training companies and suitable applicants from Morocco.

sections.heading: 1. Scope
body: The ChanceConnect brand is operated by Falconidae, owner Nabil Ayadi, Alter Heideweg 23, 44339 Dortmund.
These general terms and conditions (GTC) apply to all services provided by ChanceConnect ("we" or "ChanceConnect") to applicants and employers ("users").
Any conflicting terms of the user shall only apply if we expressly agree to them in writing.

sections.heading: 2. Subject of the services
body: ChanceConnect places international trainees and skilled workers with companies in Germany and supports the entire process — from application and the visa procedure to arrival and integration.
The specific scope of services results from the respective agreement and the descriptions on this website.

sections.heading: 3. Formation of the contract
body: The presentation of our services on the website does not constitute a binding offer. A contract is only concluded once we expressly accept a request or begin providing the service.

sections.heading: 4. User obligations to cooperate
body: The user shall provide all information and documents required for placement completely and truthfully and keep them up to date.
The user is responsible for the accuracy of the data, certificates and proof of qualifications submitted.

sections.heading: 5. Fees
body: Placement is free of charge for applicants. For employers, any fee is governed by the individual agreement.
Unless otherwise agreed, the user incurs no costs from using this website.

sections.heading: 6. No placement guarantee
body: We provide our services with the utmost care but do not owe any particular outcome. There is no entitlement to the conclusion of a training or employment relationship or to the granting of a visa.
Decisions by employers and authorities are beyond our control.

sections.heading: 7. Liability
body: We are liable without limitation for intent and gross negligence as well as for damage arising from injury to life, body or health.
In the case of simple negligence, we are liable only for the breach of a material contractual obligation and limited to the foreseeable damage typical of the contract.

sections.heading: 8. Data protection
body: Personal data is processed in accordance with our privacy policy.

sections.heading: 9. Right of withdrawal
body: Consumers have a statutory right of withdrawal. We provide the details separately in a withdrawal notice before the contract is concluded.

sections.heading: 10. Final provisions
